g.text: Direction and interval-order controls at native difficulty
Native observational strata, not synthetic reversals. Motion classes are right/up/left/down; orientation is signed change. Other binary tasks report
which frame contains the stronger quantity or structured contour. Points show empirical accuracy and95% Wilson intervals. These sensory tasks have
no spatial cue and cannot establish selective attention by themselves.
